title: Quasar formed within a mere 630 million years of the Big Bang discovered

blocks.text: CAPE CANAVERAL, Florida — Scientists have discovered the most distant quasar yet, the core of a galaxy with a slow-chomping black hole at its center dating back to nearly the dawn of the universe. The quasar formed within 630 million years of the universe-forming Big Bang, a German-led team reported Tuesday. That’s considered a very early development in the 13.8 billion-year history of the cosmos, and it smashes previous records. A quasar is an astronomical object of very high luminosity found in the centers of some galaxies and powered by gas spiraling at highvelocity into an extremely large black hole.
